Creativity Measures.evidence_source: An expanded version of the CAQ was used to assess creative achievements (see the Appendix).

Domain classified.evidence_source: The CAQ includes the following 10 domains: inventions and innovations, music, theater/TV/film, scientific discovery, creative writing, dance, culinary arts, visual art, humor, and architecture.

Number of studies.evidence_source: The text describes a single assessment process using an expanded CAQ, implying one study.

section_summary.extract_value: This section details the assessment of creative achievements using an expanded version of the Creativity Achievement Questionnaire (CAQ). Participants completed this questionnaire after a main personality assessment. The expanded CAQ covers 10 domains, including inventions, music, scientific discovery, and visual art, with scores standardized and log-transformed. This describes a single study, referred to as Study X.
section_summary.evidence_source: The entire section text describes the methodology for assessing creative achievements using an expanded CAQ, its domains, and scoring procedures.
